run_regenerate_sawtooth_refs: run the sawtooth reference regeneration script with --write_to_file to save new reference values
calculate_sawtooth_crash_references: calculate sawtooth crash reference values by running a simulation step and returning post-crash profiles
get_sawtooth_test_config: get the sawtooth test configuration dictionary with numerics, profiles, geometry, and MHD settings
get_references_path: get the file path to the sawtooth_references.json file in the TORAX source tree
run_regenerate_with_custom_output: run the sawtooth reference regeneration script with --output_dir to write references to a custom directory
